active_family: 662a state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; no strong rolling mean subtraction in first implementation
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: 662a showed that state-aware normalized innovations are learnable for anchor factors and preserve joint co-movement, but the IV log-level data object is not support-respecting. Rare generated positive log-increment paths compound over 30 days and exponentiate into impossible IV levels even on train-tail.
last_result_summary: 662a trained three scopes with one fixed backend/object: IV-only, anchor-only, and joint38. IV-only scored 2/11 on validation and 2/11 on train-tail with explosion rates 85.0% and 84.3%. Joint38 scored 3/11 validation and 2/11 train-tail with explosion rates 95.4% and 94.1%. Anchor-only panel diagnostics were healthy: train-tail factor KS mean 0.088 with 12/13 KS pass, 13/13 q99-tail pass, and factor-factor corr shape 0.951; validation KS mean 0.158 with 9/13 KS pass, 13/13 q99-tail pass, and factor-factor corr shape 0.903. Joint co-movement was also learned: validation factor-factor corr shape 0.849 and IV-factor corr shape 0.883; train-tail 0.937 and 0.882. Generated-coordinate diagnostics showed IV normalized q99 mostly plausible (IV-only 23/25 pass, joint38 35/38 pass) and exact oracle reconstruction, but generated raw IV max reached 4.8e24 and 3.35e31.
next_step_recommendation: Continue current methodology with the smallest data-object fix: keep AR flow matching, Transformer conditioning, and normalized innovations fixed, but replace the IV/surface log-level coordinate with a support-aware bounded coordinate so reconstructed IV paths cannot exponentiate to impossible levels. Rerun IV-only, anchor-only, and joint38 audits before considering any backend switch.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. For native IV+anchor joint generation, 641a/647a remain more defensible than 661a because they preserve one shared stochastic model while using mixed generated coordinates; 661a is a negative falsifier for absolute-level empirical-score lifting. 656a remains only a diagnostic stress-deck overlay because it is composed post hoc rather than generated by one mechanism.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
